## 1. A meeting's note lives where its work is (#167) — target state

A meeting app writes its notes into Imprimatur, so what was agreed reaches the task it was about.

- **A `meeting` record:** the whole note as its body, with date, title and participants. It hangs on the task the meeting was about (a ticket's task), or on the repo's "Meetings" task when it was about no single task.
- **Decisions and to-dos as their own records:** each becomes a `decision` or `todo` record whose `parent_id` is the meeting; a to-do keeps who took it.
- **Written again:** a regenerated note updates the same meeting record and replaces its children; no copies (keyed by the app's own meeting id).
- **Undone:** the meeting and its children are dropped.
- **Everywhere records are:** synced like every record, searchable through the MCP tools, and listed in the VS Code panel in a "Meetings" view per task.
- **Limited writer:** an app device may push only meeting records and their children, never other records.

First user: a desktop meeting app writing work meeting notes to its work repo, then its past notes once.

## 2. Meetings page: this repo only, grouped by month, real meeting names, decisions and to-dos side by side

The user saw halil-workspace meetings on imprimatur's Meetings page and found the list hard to read: 12 rows titled "Toplantı" and every row looking the same.

- Scope: the page always shows the current repo. The sticky "every repo" scope (set when you open another repo's task) has no switch on this page, so it was mixing repos in without showing it.
- Name: a generic title ("Toplantı", "Meeting", "Yarıda kalan kayıt…") gives way to the note's first bold line, which is where the meeting app puts the real name. The stored title stays as written.
- Row: a date tile, the name, the summary's first sentence ("## Özet"), a decisions count and your open to-dos count (accent colour). Rows are grouped under month headings.
- Opened: Decisions and To-dos in two columns, yours first, then the task link and the full note.
- The Meetings tab gets an icon (Lucide "users").

Shipped in 0.133.0.
